town_description: Nagaur is a historic town in central Rajasthan, once the capital of the Jangladesh region and ruled by the Nagaur Chauhan Rajputs. It is known for Nagaur Fort (Ahhichatragarh), the Tarkeen Dargah, traditional havelis, and the annual Nagaur Cattle Fair, one of Asia's largest livestock fairs. The town is on the Jodhpur-Bikaner rail line.
